body:
Updates public-facing branding across the repository from ``Swarm Spawner`` / ``@taurus-ai/swarm-spawner`` to ``GRIDERA Migrate`` / ``@gridera/migrate``.

What changed:
- ``package.json``: package name, binary name, repository URL
- ``package-lock.json``: lockfile name/binary updated
- ``README.md``, ``CHANGELOG.md``: project name, install/import examples, links
- ``src/cli.ts``: CLI banner, examples, docs links, pricing URL
- ``src/tier-enforcer.ts``, ``src/hedera-integration.ts``: branding/comments
- ``pyproject.toml``, ``src-go/go.mod``, ``src-rs/Cargo.toml``: package/module names
- ``integrations/vscode/``: command IDs and package name
- ``playground.html`` / ``playground.src.html``: page title, install snippets, copy text
- ``examples/``: import paths and comments
- ``docs/specs/``: design spec references updated
- ``tests/tier-enforcer.test.ts``: expected pricing URL updated

Class names such as ``SwarmSpawner``, ``SwarmConfig``, and ``SpawnRequest`` are intentionally preserved to avoid breaking the public API. Only repo/package/binary/comment strings are rebranded.

Note: The new ``migrate.gridera.net`` domain is used as a placeholder for the old ``swarm-spawner.dev`` URL.
title: Rebrand Swarm Spawner → GRIDERA Migrate
